Arabic text: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِيْ جَعَلَ كَمَالَ دِينِهِ
Translation: Praise be to Allah who made the perfection of His religion
and the completion of His favor
through the guardianship of the Commander of the Faithful

Arabic text: عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِيْ طَالِبٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ
Translation: Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him
